metadata.v1_20_update: 2026-04-17: Phase-2 close on the B2 Start-of-Round DC Effects Sequencing row (inferred_only since v1.0). Inventory confirmed three-layer structure: Block A at runStartOfRoundDcEffects lines 1078-1158 resolves DC passive hooks in initiative-first order (_sorPlayerOrder = _initPn === 1 ? [1,2] : [2,1]) for Brush, Force Slow, Excavation, Programming Override, Shape/Shift; Block B at 1160-1262 resolves Skirmish Upgrades in fixed [1,2] order for First Strike, Rule by Fear, Rogue One, Imperial Citadel; return value `(game.pendingStartOfRoundResolve || 0) > 0` gates the activation phase via resolveStartOfRoundEffect which clears the counter and calls sendPhaseGateMessages(..., 'pre_activation'). Existing round-lifecycle-tests + round-lifecycle-behavioral tests covered the gate flow at a high level but no test pinned the Block A/Block B ordering, the round-1 guards (First Strike firstStrikeFired + Rule by Fear/Rogue One per-player flags), the once-per-game semantics for both-player-own cases, or the counter→gate transition. New oracle file tests/domain/oracle/sor-sequencing-probes.test.js adds 17 assertions across 6 probe groups: SOR-001 return-value semantics, SOR-002 First Strike (round-1 guard + owner-agnostic + both-own-fires-once), SOR-003 Ezra Brush (every-round sync, defeated-skipped), SOR-004 Block A initiative-first ordering via Ezra×2 log-order probe, SOR-005 resolveStartOfRoundEffect counter + phase-gate transition, SOR-006 source pin on the structural invariants. Representative-sync probe approach (Brush + First Strike) rather than picker-Discord end-to-end — Rule by Fear/Rogue One/Imperial Citadel/Programming Override/Clawdite Shape-Shift paths are covered by SOR-001's counter-increment contract and SOR-006's source pin since those paths all funnel through pendingStartOfRoundResolve. REAL BUG SURFACED + FIXED: runStartOfRoundDcEffects at round.js:1071 only destructured { logGameAction, updateHandChannelMessages } from ctx, but called checkWinConditions(game, client) at line 1179 inside the First Strike branch — ReferenceError on round 1 whenever either player owns [First Strike]. Fixed by adding checkWinConditions to the destructure + propagating through the two active call sites (round.js:923 _continueAfterMissionSor and setup-bridge.js:459 fallback path). phaseGate and ccHand CONTEXT_GROUPS already declared checkWinConditions so no group wiring change. Zero regressions: 1883/1883 npm test green. Row reclassified inferred_only → direct_oracle. Distribution: direct_oracle 49 → 50, inferred_only 3 → 2, total unchanged at 58. Latent risk flagged (not patched): Block B fixed [1,2] ordering ignores initiative — currently safe because all four Skirmish Upgrades are self-contained, but order-sensitive future upgrades would silently drift.

metadata.v1_18_update: 2026-04-17: Phase-2 geometry fix for the LOS-06 A3 lane opened in v1.17. Root cause traced in src/game/spatial.js hasLineOfSight: diagonal corner-threading rays from corner-inset points (INSET=0.49) produced very short segments (~0.028 length for the a1→b2 case) that (a) segmentsStrictlyIntersect could not detect because wall endpoints sit at t=0 or t=1 and the EPS guard excludes them, and (b) getCellsAlongLine's Math.round rasterizer sampled only the source and destination cells for such short rays (both self-excluded), so diagonal blocker pairs like {a2, b1} were invisible. Fix: additive corner-obstacle counter. New getThreadedCorners helper enumerates every half-integer grid corner the open segment threads (only diagonal-slope rays can thread corners — axis-aligned rays never do, so blast radius is narrow). Inside the per-target-corner loop, for each threaded corner count blocking cells touching the corner (minus source/dest per existing pattern) plus wall segments with an endpoint at the corner; count>=2 means the ray is blocked. Ranked three fix designs: (1) explicit corner-obstacle counter [chosen — low blast radius, additive, doesn't touch EPS/rasterizer], (2) relax segmentsStrictlyIntersect EPS guard [rejected — would change behavior of every wall skim across the codebase], (3) adjust rasterizer to emit all 4 diagonal cells near corner crossings [rejected — Math.round bias is load-bearing for many non-corner diagonal rays]. A3 probes flipped from measured-broken (assert true + notStrictEqual losCrr) to CRR-correct (assert false); DC-005 source pin extended to cover getThreadedCorners + count>=2 so any refactor removing the counter trips the pin. Full npm test: 1847/1847 pass, zero regressions across the ten-plus LOS-touching test files. Distribution unchanged (58 total, direct_oracle 48) — this is a correctness closure, not a coverage expansion.
metadata.v1_17_update: 2026-04-17: Phase-2 close on the LOS-06 A3 mini-lane (diagonal-corner shield intersection) deferred since v1.5. Classified as a geometry-rule assertion lane (not engine/handler drift — both sides share src/game/spatial.js hasLineOfSight). New oracle file tests/domain/oracle/los-06-diagonal-corner-probes.test.js adds 6 probes: PROBE-LOS-06-DC-001 (single-obstacle-at-corner passes — CRR carveout, positive control), DC-002 (shield-shield diagonal corner), DC-003 (shield + wall corner), DC-004 (wall + wall corner, shield-free control proving the gap is geometric not shield-specific), DC-005 (source pin on INSET=0.49 + segmentsStrictlyIntersect EPS bounds + Math.round rasterizer + source/dest self-exclusion). Gap is honestly measured: DC-002/003/004 pin the current CRR-violating output (true) with a paired assert.notStrictEqual(..., losCrr) companion assertion that fires if the geometry is ever fixed — follows the same honest-measurement pattern as v1.6 PROBE-LOADOUT-05 (electro-pulse). Root cause: segmentsStrictlyIntersect excludes wall endpoints (t,u > EPS && < 1-EPS), so a ray threading an exact wall-endpoint corner is not caught; Math.round rasterization in getCellsAlongLine samples only source/dest cells for the very short (0.49,0.49)→(0.51,0.51) corner-threading ray and misses diagonal blocker pairs. Fix requires adding an explicit corner-intersection check to hasLineOfSight — tracked as a separate gameplay lane, not in this pass. One new heat-map row added (LOS A3 Diagonal-corner shield intersection); direct_oracle classification. Existing LOS-06 row v1.5 note amended to reflect closure. Distribution: direct_oracle 47 → 48, total 57 → 58.

metadata.methodology: Four-domain audit of engine source against Consolidated Rules Reference. Coverage classified as: direct_oracle (pure-function oracle probe), runtime_invariant (RT-1..RT-12 checked in training loop), certification (card catalog regression), unit_test (co-located or tests/domain unit), headless_selfplay (end-to-end headless game), inferred_only (exercised by selfplay but never explicitly asserted), uncovered (no test or runtime check).

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Each activation grants exactly 2 actions; specials/moves/attacks each cost 1 unless modified
coverage.evidence: PROBE-AS-001..AS-010 (action-surfacing-probes*.test.js) pin remaining-action gates for move, attack, dc_special, cc_special, cc_double
coverage.notes: Core action budget is well-pinned. 10 probes across 3 batch files.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Move action offered when remaining >= 1 and not blocked by stun/massive-lock
coverage.evidence: PROBE-AS-005 (activationExtraActionThenStun blocks move), PROBE-AS-006 (massiveMovementLocked blocks move)
coverage.notes: Both movement-blocking gates tested with positive+negative pairs.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Attack offered once per activation unless Assault or free-attack flag set
coverage.evidence: PROBE-AS-007 (Assault), PROBE-FA-001..FA-003 (freeAttackBonusPending, imperialRetrofittingMultiAttack, fellSwoopFreeAttack), PROBE-FA-001b (paired negative)
coverage.notes: 5 of 5 bypass flags tested. Assault keyword tested via Baze Malbus.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Interact offered only to sentient non-companion figures at valid interact targets; blocked by Non-Sentient trait, companion status, Alter Mind
coverage.evidence: PROBE-INT-001..INT-005 (interact-legality-probes.test.js): Non-Sentient blocked, companion blocked, normal offered, Beast Tamer override, Alter Mind blocks interact
coverage.notes: All 4 interact gates tested. Terminal position h21 on mos-eisley-outskirts verified.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: DC special actions offered when remaining actions >= cost (all currently cost 1)
coverage.evidence: PROBE-AS-009 (remaining=1 offered, remaining=0 blocked for Bossk Indiscriminate Fire)
coverage.notes: No DC currently has specialCosts > 1; all default via ?? 1.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: CC special actions require remaining >= 1; CC Double (On the Lam) requires remaining >= 2
coverage.evidence: PROBE-AS-010 (CC special blocked at remaining=0), PROBE-AS-008 (CC Double at remaining=2 vs <2)
coverage.notes: Both gates pinned with paired positive/negative probes.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Movement uses BFS on adjacency graph; terrain modifiers apply per edge (difficult = +1, impassable = blocked)
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/movement-*.test.js (6 files, ~200 probes): pathfinding, terrain costs, large figures, blocking, doors
coverage.notes: Movement is the most heavily oracle-tested subsystem.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Large (2x2) figures occupy 4 cells; all 4 must be legal; rotation allowed during movement
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/movement-large-figure*.test.js: large figure pathfinding, blocking, rotation
coverage.notes: Multiple probe files dedicated to large figure edge cases.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Abilities like Deference Protocol, Parting Blow trigger on movement through specific spaces
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/movement-trigger*.test.js, tests/domain/oracle/movement-interrupt*.test.js
coverage.notes: Core triggers tested but not all DC-specific movement triggers have dedicated probes.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Difficult terrain costs +1 movement; hostile terrain is separate effect. Combined cost should be movement+1 with hostile damage.
coverage.evidence: Difficult terrain tested individually; hostile terrain tested individually; no test combines both on same space
coverage.notes: Low risk — terrain types rarely co-occur on same cell in real maps.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Damage = attack_damage - defense_evades - defense_blocks, minimum 0. Pierce reduces blocks.
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/combat-damage*.test.js, tests/domain/oracle/combat-pierce*.test.js, src/game/damage-helpers.test.js
coverage.notes: Core damage pipeline heavily tested with many edge cases.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Ranged attacks require accuracy >= distance; melee attacks always hit if adjacent
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/combat-accuracy*.test.js: accuracy checks, range validation, miss-on-insufficient-accuracy
coverage.notes: Accuracy-range interaction well-tested.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: LOS requires unblocked corner-to-corner line between attacker and target cells; figures, walls, doors block
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/los-*.test.js (multiple files): wall blocking, figure blocking, door blocking, edge cases
coverage.notes: LOS-06 (energy shield exception) still OPEN P2. Figure-blocking LOS (Slice 1) closed. Slice 2 (doors/multi-cell/Hide/CC) deferred.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Each player may reroll once per attack (attacker then defender); reroll replaces original result
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/combat-reroll*.test.js: reroll offered/consumed, result replacement
coverage.notes: Reroll flow well-tested.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Surges can only be spent on available surge abilities; each surge ability used at most once per attack
coverage.evidence: PROBE-SURGE-001..004 (surge-legality-probes.test.js): surge chart retrieval, blockSurgeAbilities gate, double-surge prefix + parsing, legal accumulation through handler pipeline (7 assertions)
coverage.notes: Tier A upgrade. Surge chart, cost detection (double: prefix), block flag, and pipeline damage verified.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Power tokens (focus, hidden) must be applied at correct combat phase; focus adds attack die, hidden subtracts accuracy; both consumed after resolution
coverage.evidence: PROBE-TOKEN-001..003 (combat-token-timing-probes.test.js): Hidden -2 accuracy causes ranged miss through handler pipeline + paired control, Focus consumed post-resolution, Hidden consumed from both sides (4 assertions)
coverage.notes: Tier A upgrade. Semantic timing pinned: Hidden penalty in combat result, condition consumption after resolution.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Blast N deals N damage to all figures adjacent to target; Cleave N deals N damage to all adjacent hostile figures
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/combat-blast*.test.js, tests/domain/oracle/combat-cleave*.test.js
coverage.notes: AoE abilities well-covered.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Melee attacks require adjacency; ranged attacks require LOS and accuracy >= distance. isRanged flag must match weapon profile.
coverage.evidence: CERT-ATK-001..004 (attack-type-certification.test.js): all non-attachment combatants have valid type, Reach melee accuracy exempted, no unexpected types, isRanged derivation consistent, ranged DCs have accuracy dice (4 assertions, full catalog sweep)

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: CRR p.28 ENERGY SHIELD: 'The diagonal intersection of a space containing an energy shield and either a wall, door, blocking terrain, or another energy shield also blocks line of sight.' CRR p.22 LINE OF SIGHT: 'Line of sight cannot be traced through a corner where any combination of walls, doors, blocking terrain, or Energy Shield intersect.' Known geometry gap: hasLineOfSight does not detect corner-threading rays where 2+ obstacles meet. Root cause is the INSET=0.49 corner-inset combined with segmentsStrictlyIntersect's endpoint EPS exclusion (wall endpoints at the corner are not detected) and Math.round rasterization in getCellsAlongLine (very short corner-threading rays sample only source+dest cells).
coverage.engine_location: src/game/spatial.js hasLineOfSight (shared by handler and engine — not a drift lane). Fix site: add corner-intersection test counting obstacles (blocking cells + wall endpoints) at each grid corner the ray threads; 2+ → block.
coverage.evidence: PROBE-LOS-06-DC-001..005 (tests/domain/oracle/los-06-diagonal-corner-probes.test.js, 6 assertions): single-obstacle-passes carveout positive control (CRR-correct — LOS allowed), shield-shield diagonal corner (CRR-correct — LOS blocked via corner-obstacle counter), shield+wall corner (CRR-correct — LOS blocked), wall+wall corner shield-free control (CRR-correct — LOS blocked, proves fix is geometric not shield-specific), source pin on INSET=0.49 + segmentsStrictlyIntersect EPS bounds + Math.round rasterizer + source/dest self-exclusion + the new getThreadedCorners helper + count>=2 counter so any refactor trips the pin.
coverage.notes: Closed 2026-04-17 as part of v1.18 (geometry fix). Root cause: diagonal corner-threading rays (slope-1 inset rays) were invisible to both the wall-segment intersector (segmentsStrictlyIntersect excludes endpoints via t,u>EPS && <1-EPS) and the cell rasterizer (Math.round sampling of the very short (0.49,0.49)→(0.51,0.51) ray emits only source/dest cells). Fix: new getThreadedCorners helper enumerates every half-integer grid corner the segment threads; in-loop counter sums blocking cells (minus source/dest) plus wall endpoints at each threaded corner; count>=2 blocks that target-corner ray. Only diagonal-slope rays can thread corners, so axis-aligned LOS is untouched. Shared path, so handler and engine closed by one fix. Zero regressions across 1847-test npm test suite.

top_5_risks.description: No test validates that surges can only be spent on available surge abilities or that each ability is used at most once per attack. If the engine allows illegal surge spending, damage is inflated.

top_5_risks.risk: Power Token Application Timing in Combat
top_5_risks.description: Focus and Hidden tokens are tested in isolation but not in the combat flow. If tokens are applied at the wrong phase (before vs after roll), dice pool effects are wrong.
isConditionImmune tested in isolation but never exercised through a combat resolution that attempts to apply a condition to an immune figure.
top_5_risks.recommended_action: RECLASSIFIED — ORACLE-HANDLER-003 already covered this at handler level

top_5_risks.description: No test validates that the isRanged flag in DC data matches the card's actual weapon type. A wrong flag would let melee figures attack at range or ranged figures only attack adjacent.
When all figures in a multi-figure deployment group are defeated, the group's activation should be removed from the round. No test verifies this for groups of 2+ figures.
